Privacy Policy

Last updated: 24 November 2026

1. Who we are

GB GROUP ("we", "us") operates this website. For questions about this policy or your information, write to ceo@gbgroup.co.in or call 74397 86518.

2. Information we collect

When you submit an enquiry we collect the details you choose to provide:

  • Your name and mobile number (required).
  • Your email address, if you provide one.
  • The service you select and the message you write.
  • Your agreement to be contacted about that enquiry.

3. How an enquiry is handled

Enquiries are sent to our team using WhatsApp and/or email. If a secure lead endpoint has been configured for this deployment, the details are also delivered to that endpoint. We use the information only to respond to your enquiry and to provide the service you asked about. We do not sell your details.

4. Cookies and analytics

This site does not set advertising cookies. If Google Analytics has been configured for this deployment, it records anonymised usage events such as page views and contact-link clicks to help us understand which pages are useful. Otherwise, no analytics script loads.

5. Third-party services

WhatsApp (Meta), your email client, Google Maps on the contact page, and Google Analytics where enabled are third-party services with their own privacy terms. Opening a WhatsApp or Maps link takes you to those services.

6. Retention and your choices

We keep enquiry details for as long as needed to handle the request and for reasonable business records. You can ask us to access, correct or delete the details you shared by contacting us using the details in section 1.

7. Images on this website

Some photographs are illustrative and representative of the type of work described. They are not representations of specific GB GROUP projects, clients, employees or properties unless explicitly stated.

8. Changes

We may update this policy when our processes change. The date above always shows the latest version.
